Accounting Export
📤 One-way export into your accounting software — this ERP does not keep its own general ledger. Export a batch, import it into Tally / Zoho Books / your tool of choice, then reconcile there. Tally XML and Zoho CSV follow each tool's documented import schema; import one test batch and have your accountant verify the postings before relying on it for bulk import.

to
Auto-created when a Lead with a registered referral partner (Architect/Builder/B2B Partner — set their commission % in Partners & Referrals) is marked Won. Commission is calculated against the matching Won quotation's value, or the lead's estimated value if no quotation exists yet.

Cost vs Payment Monitoring
Company-wide, all-time. Combines Vendor Bills and Referral Commissions — the two obligation types this app tracks as "incurred now, paid later" — into one payables view, plus a cash-vs-accrual reconciliation (Cost Incurred is an accounting figure; Cash Paid Out is what's actually left the bank).

Job Work Analysis
Manufacturing Cost Analytics
🧾 Material and Labour reuse the real figures Product Costing already computes from Material Issues/Returns/Labour vouchers. Machine Cost and Overhead are new — Machine Cost from logged operation hours × each machine's hourly rate, Overhead at the same % used at quotation time. This is a pure analytical report — it does not post to the Financial Engine or the General Ledger; Material/Labour already post via their own real transaction flows elsewhere, and posting Machine Cost/Overhead here would misrepresent an internal allocation as a real transaction.

Purchase & Vendor Report
Procurement Intelligence
Per-vendor scorecard — the Purchase & Vendor Report already shows spend/PO-status per vendor; this turns the company-wide On-Time Delivery KPI and the Bill-vs-PO variance flagging (Vendor Bills) into a per-vendor breakdown so a specific problem vendor can actually be identified, not just the company average.
VendorPOsPO Value ₹On-Time DeliveryBills w/ VarianceVariance ₹Outstanding ₹
Vendor Rating & Scorecard
Every metric is computed from real transactions. Response Time is honestly marked "Not Tracked" — no RFQ/quote-request workflow exists in this ERP to measure it against. Payment History is shown as business-volume context, not a vendor score, since it reflects our payment behaviour, not the vendor's performance.
VendorOverall RatingDeliveryQualityPrice vs MarketOutstanding ₹
Enterprise Insights
A rule-based insights engine — not machine learning, not a black box. Every card states the exact threshold that triggered it, computed from data already tracked elsewhere in this app (Project Performance, Procurement Intelligence, Data Quality & BI, Cost vs Payment, Deliverables, Tasks). Nothing here is a prediction — it's a prioritized "so what" reading of numbers that already exist, cross-referenced across modules that don't otherwise talk to each other.

Approval Workflows
Configurable Delegation-of-Authority rules — for each transaction type, tiers of "up to this value, this role must approve." Editing these changes real, live approval gates immediately, no code change needed. Only transaction types with an actual enforcement point in the app are listed below.
Data Migration
Opening Balances
Set each account's starting balance as of your ERP go-live date (from your previous bookkeeping records or accountant's trial balance) — not a reconstruction of every historical transaction. Any imbalance automatically posts to Opening Balance Equity so the books stay correctly balanced; true that up against real Capital later if needed.
CodeAccountTypeOpening Balance ₹
Bulk Import — Master Data
Import Customers, Vendors, Item Master, Projects, or Leads from a CSV export of your previous system. Existing records are matched by name (or Project Code) and skipped, never duplicated. Historical transactions (invoices/bills/receipts) aren't bulk-imported here — use Opening Balances above for the financial position those represent as of go-live.

RFQ — Request for Quotation
Send a requirement (one or more items) to one or more vendors and record when each one actually responds — this is the real timestamp pair Vendor Rating's Response Time metric needs. A vendor's quoted rate is their total for the whole RFQ, not per line item. Closing an RFQ just records the selected vendor and rate; raise the PO itself the normal way from Purchase Orders.
